en: Black‑and‑white historic view of a riverside city boulevard in winter, with pedestrians, a tramcar, horse‑drawn vehicles, leafless trees, and moored steamships along a wide river. On the opposite bank, a large hillside crowned with expansive palace‑like buildings rises above the water; a tall church spire and other historic structures dominate the skyline. In the foreground stands a multi‑storey, ornate 19th‑century building with flags on its roof and a statue in front, while the broad quay and embankment are busy with people and kiosks. The style suggests an early 20th‑century European city postcard.
